Container.Name: CraftControl-FRP-Server
Container.Overview: Fast Reverse Proxy (FRP) Server for CraftControl. Tunnels Minecraft server ports from daemon nodes to this central server so players can connect.

Config.Name: FRP Bind Port
Config.Description: FRP control port for daemon node connections

Config.Name: MC Tunnel Port Range Start
Config.Description: Start of the port range for tunneled Minecraft servers

Config.Name: MC Tunnel Port Range End
Config.Description: End of the port range for tunneled Minecraft servers (supports up to 100 servers)

Config.Name: FRP Config File
Config.Description: Path to your frps.toml configuration file on the host
